speaker: Doctor
text:
That sudden onset during exercise is highly suggestive of a disc rupture. To confirm if this is a lumbar disc herniation and to check for cauda equina syndrome, can you tell me if you have any loss of bowel or bladder control, or numbness in the saddle area? Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain right now?

I apologize for the confusion, but I must clarify that your symptoms of acute lower back pain radiating to the leg following exercise are classic signs of a lumbar disc herniation, not iron deficiency anemia. To proceed with the correct diagnosis for your current presentation, I will need to know if you have any numbness in the "saddle" area or any difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels, as these are urgent signs of cauda equina syndrome.
